source.camera: SR-90 (Imperial Hwy) at Harbor Blvd, CCTV 506, Caltrans District 12

definition.what_is_counted: A vehicle whose body crosses the vertical line x=600 within y=[300,680], travelling LEFT to RIGHT.
excluded: vehicles that approach but stop short without crossing
definition.note: Defined by pixel geometry. The line spans two visible flow bands (y~324-441 and y~519-634); an earlier concern that these might be different movements is RESOLVED - they are both eastbound and are deliberately counted together as one approach.
definition.movement_scope: EASTBOUND APPROACH VOLUME. The user counted left-turning AND through vehicles together - every vehicle travelling left to right across the line, regardless of where it subsequently goes. This is an approach volume, matching step 1 of the ladder (volumes, one leg). Clarified by the user 2026-10-02.

claude.method: paired virtual tripwires at x=580 and x=620, background-subtracted, peak-paired per lane row; direction from which line fires first. 43 raw (row,vehicle) events -> 33 L->R -> merged across rows within 0.5s -> ~15 vehicles.
known_weaknesses: Row merging is ambiguous: groups like t=28.92/29.44/29.68 could be one slow vehicle or two.
No frame-by-frame review was possible; this is an instrument reading, not a careful human count.
NOT precise enough to serve as ground truth on its own.
claude.outcome: WRONG - 15 vs reference 20 (-25%). True value fell OUTSIDE the stated +/-3 band.

user.method: independent visual count of GT_count_clip.mp4, watched in full
user.provenance: CONFIRMED 2026-10-02. The user explicitly stated on 2026-10-02 that they had NOT yet watched the clip; the benchmark was reverted to provisional, the clip was served locally, the user watched it, and returned 20. The value matches the earlier unverified figure, but it is now a counted number rather than an asserted one.

reconciled.basis: User counted the clip directly with scrub/replay. Claude could not dispute it: sweeping the merge rule in Claude's detector-free instrument yields 16-24 on parameter choice alone, so the instrument has no power to adjudicate. See lessons.md L-001.
reconciled.residual_uncertainty: Rests on ONE human count. A second independent human count would strengthen it. Claude's count was not an equal second opinion - the instrument was demonstrably weaker.

cross_checks.comment: Spread of 12-24 across methods. None is ground truth. This spread is precisely why the benchmark is needed.

claude_merge_rule_sweep.comment: The count moves 50% on merge-parameter choice alone. The rule that reproduces 20 was deliberately NOT selected - that would make the benchmark circular.

sanity_signals.quiet_period: No events between t=47s and t=60s - consistent with a red phase.
sanity_signals.platoon_structure: Events cluster from t=17s and t=32s onward, consistent with queue discharge after green.

error_analysis.performed: 2026-10-02, user reviewed QA_review.mp4 crossing by crossing
error_analysis.finding: Exactly one false positive: crossing #1 at t=2.40s. The user: "it is not going from left to right, but it is going from up to down. It just crosses the pink line." All other 20 confirmed genuine.
error_analysis.root_cause: Direction was judged from the track OVERALL displacement plus the sign of dx at the line. A vehicle moving predominantly downward with slight rightward drift satisfies both while not being an eastbound movement.
error_analysis.fix: Judge direction from LOCAL motion at the crossing and require it to be predominantly PERPENDICULAR to the tripwire (angle from horizontal <= 30 deg for a vertical line).
error_analysis.separation: False positive at 35.6 deg; the 20 genuine crossings span 5.4-18.4 deg. Threshold sweep: 20-30 deg all give exactly 20; 40 deg+ gives 21. Wide plateau, bimodal data - a discriminator, not a tuned knob.
error_analysis.also_corrected: An earlier figure of 24 was wrong: it included 3 crossings at t=63.0/108.1/109.3s, outside the 60s window. Tracks were selected by START frame rather than CROSSING frame. In-window total is 21.

scores.IMPORTANT: These are IN-SAMPLE. The method was corrected using this benchmark, so its score here is optimistic by construction. A held-out benchmark is required for an out-of-sample figure.
